plot_acts.title_zh: 定义：食物如何划分归属
plot_acts.zh: Parasecoli 先给出定义：美食民族主义是把食物当作「谁属于这里」的判准，它既可是防卫性的，也可是攻击性的。
plot_acts.en: Parasecoli begins with a definition: gastronativism makes food the criterion of who belongs, and it can be defensive or aggressive.

brief.main: 食物不只是象征，而是 membership 的行政技术。
brief.flow: 从日常饮食，到归属判断，再到政治动员。
brief.link: 为后续案例提供分析尺规。
brief.main_en: Food is not only symbol but an administrative technique of membership.
brief.flow_en: From everyday eating to judgments of belonging to political mobilisation.
brief.link_en: Supplies the gauge for the cases that follow.

plot_acts.title_en: A spectrum: from resistance to exclusion
plot_acts.zh: 核心论证是一个光谱：同一套「我们的食物」话语，既可以抵抗跨国资本与文化同质化，也可以转化为对外来者的排斥。
plot_acts.en: The core argument is a spectrum: the same discourse of 'our food' can resist corporate capital and homogenisation, or turn into exclusion of outsiders.

brief.main: 同一句话，可以是盾，也可以是刀。
brief.flow: 从保护传统，到划界，再到排斥。
brief.names: 慢食运动、本土主义者、移民社群。
brief.link: 避免把食物运动一律浪漫化。
brief.main_en: The same sentence can be a shield or a knife.
brief.flow_en: From protecting tradition to drawing boundaries to exclusion.

plot_acts.title_zh: 全球现象，而非穷国特产
plot_acts.title_en: A global phenomenon, not a poor-country speciality
plot_acts.zh: Parasecoli 强调美食民族主义不是「落后地区」的症候：从欧洲的产地保护到北美的精酿与本土运动，它同样发生在富国与精英层。
plot_acts.en: Parasecoli stresses that gastronativism is not a symptom of 'backward regions': from European origin protection to North American craft and localist movements, it occurs in rich countries and among elites too.

brief.main: 排外不只属于底层焦虑，也属于品味政治。
brief.flow: 从欧洲，到北美，再到全球南方。
brief.names: 地理标志、精酿、农夫市集。
brief.link: 把概念从「民粹」扩展为「治理术」。
brief.main_en: Exclusion belongs not only to working-class anxiety but to taste politics.
brief.flow_en: From Europe to North America to the global South.
brief.names_en: Geographical indications, craft beer, farmers' markets.
brief.link_en: Widens the concept from populism to governmentality.

plot_acts.title_en: Limits: can the concept bear the weight
plot_acts.zh: 结论讨论概念的边界：当一切食物政治都被称作「美食民族主义」，它是否还区分得开保护、排斥与单纯的乡愁？
plot_acts.en: The conclusion asks about the concept's boundary: if all food politics is called gastronativism, can it still distinguish protection, exclusion and plain nostalgia?

brief.main: 一个太好用的概念，往往失去分辨力。
brief.flow: 从类型学，到滑移风险，再到分析建议。
brief.main_en: A concept that is too usable tends to lose discrimination.
brief.flow_en: From typology to the risk of slippage to analytical advice.
brief.link_en: Turns the definitional work back on itself.

plot_acts.zh: 开篇命名一种跨国审美：裸露砖墙、爱迪生灯泡、粗木长桌、单一产地咖啡——它看起来极本地，其实是一套全球流通的设计语法。
plot_acts.en: The opening names a transnational aesthetic: exposed brick, Edison bulbs, rough wooden tables, single-origin coffee — it looks hyper-local but is a globally circulating design grammar.

brief.main: 地方感是可以被设计、被复制的。
brief.flow: 从视觉符号，到空间语法，再到全球流通。
brief.link: 为全书提供可辨识的对象。
brief.main_en: A sense of place can be designed and reproduced.
brief.flow_en: From visual signs to spatial grammar to global circulation.
brief.link_en: Gives the book a recognisable object.

plot_acts.zh: 各城市章展示同一套语法如何被本地化：在布鲁克林、伦敦、东京、圣保罗，同样的材料被用来讲述不同的地方故事。
plot_acts.en: City chapters show the same grammar localised: in Brooklyn, London, Tokyo and São Paulo the same materials tell different local stories.

brief.main: 全球化不是复制，而是同一语法的不同方言。
brief.flow: 从全球语法，到城市变体，再到地方叙事。
brief.names: 布鲁克林、伦敦、东京、圣保罗。
brief.link: 把抽象体制落成可比较的田野。
brief.main_en: Globalisation is not copying but dialects of one grammar.
brief.flow_en: From global grammar to urban variants to local narrative.
brief.link_en: Grounds the abstract regime in comparable fieldwork.

plot_acts.title_en: Who is invited, who is excluded
plot_acts.zh: 全书的政治锋芒在此：这套审美伴随租金上涨、街区绅士化与人口置换，「地方感」的生产同时是驱逐的生产。
plot_acts.en: Here lies the book's political edge: the aesthetic arrives with rising rents, gentrification and displacement, so producing a sense of place is also producing eviction.

brief.main: 审美中立的背后是地产逻辑。
brief.flow: 从风格，到租金，再到人口置换。
brief.link: 把食物研究接回城市政治经济学。
brief.main_en: Behind the neutral aesthetic lies real-estate logic.
brief.flow_en: From style to rent to displacement.
brief.link_en: Reconnects food studies to urban political economy.

plot_acts.zh: 书名的问题很具体：一道家常饺子，如何同时成为民族象征、手工遗产与全球市场上的商品？
plot_acts.en: The title's question is concrete: how does a homely dumpling become at once national symbol, craft heritage and commodity on a global market?

brief.main: 一道菜可以同时是三种东西。
brief.flow: 从家常，到象征，再到商品。
brief.main_en: One dish can be three things at once.
brief.flow_en: From home cooking to symbol to commodity.

plot_acts.title_zh: 后社会主义的味觉重组
plot_acts.zh: 1989 年后的消费转型重塑了波兰食物：国有食品工业解体，私营餐馆、进口食材与「回归传统」同时出现。
plot_acts.en: Post-1989 consumer transformation reshaped Polish food: the state food industry dissolved, and private restaurants, imported ingredients and a 'return to tradition' appeared together.

brief.main: 「传统」常常是在断裂之后被发明的。
brief.flow: 从计划经济，到市场转型，再到传统复兴。
brief.names: 国营工厂、新中产、餐饮创业者。
brief.link: 解释为何「本地」在此刻变得可售。
brief.main_en: 'Tradition' is often invented after a rupture.
brief.flow_en: From planned economy to market transition to revival of tradition.
brief.names_en: State factories, new middle class, restaurant entrepreneurs.
brief.link_en: Explains why 'the local' became sellable at that moment.

plot_acts.title_zh: 世界主义胃口与本土主义修辞
plot_acts.zh: 结论指出二者并不互斥：同一批消费者既享受全球美食，也要求「真正的波兰味道」；世界主义可以是一种更精致的本土主义。
plot_acts.en: The conclusion argues the two are not mutually exclusive: the same consumers enjoy global food and demand 'authentic Polish taste'; cosmopolitanism can be a more refined nativism.

brief.main: 开放的口味与封闭的身份可以共存。
brief.flow: 从消费实践，到身份叙事，再到政治含义。
brief.names: 城市中产、美食媒体、民族话语。
brief.link: 回应《美食民族主义》的光谱论。
brief.main_en: Open taste and closed identity can coexist.
brief.flow_en: From consumption to identity narrative to political meaning.
brief.names_en: Urban middle class, food media, national discourse.
brief.link_en: Answers the spectrum argument of Gastronativism.

plot_acts.title_zh: 标签之前：传统如何成为资源
plot_acts.title_en: Before the label: how tradition becomes a resource
plot_acts.zh: 先讲制度史：欧盟的原产地命名（PDO/PGI）如何把「地方传统」转成可保护、可交易的知识产权对象。
plot_acts.en: The institutional history first: how EU designations (PDO/PGI) turned 'local tradition' into a protectable, tradeable object of intellectual property.

brief.main: 要让传统受保护，先要把它写成文件。
brief.flow: 从地方实践，到法规文本，再到市场准入。
brief.link: 为比较案例设定制度基线。
brief.main_en: To protect tradition, first write it into a document.
brief.flow_en: From local practice to legal text to market access.
brief.link_en: Sets the institutional baseline for comparison.

plot_acts.title_zh: 比较：欧洲之外的原产地政治
plot_acts.zh: 把视野移到哥斯达黎加、泰国、印度等地：当「风土」被引入没有相应法律传统的国家，它同时带来赋权与新的不平等。
plot_acts.en: The view shifts to Costa Rica, Thailand and India: when terroir is imported into countries without that legal tradition, it brings empowerment and new inequality at once.

brief.main: 同一工具，在不同制度里长出不同结果。
brief.flow: 从欧洲模型，到南方国家的挪用，再到本地后果。
brief.link: 把欧洲中心的概念相对化。
brief.main_en: The same tool grows different outcomes in different institutions.
brief.flow_en: From the European model to Southern appropriation to local consequences.

plot_acts.zh: 结论主张标签是双刃：它能保住价格与知识，也能把不合规的小生产者、移民与传统变体排除在「正宗」之外。
plot_acts.en: The conclusion argues labels cut both ways: they defend prices and knowledge, and exclude non-compliant smallholders, migrants and variant traditions from 'authenticity'.

brief.main: 正宗的每一次定义，都是一次排除。
brief.flow: 从保护效果，到排除机制，再到政策建议。
brief.link: 把食物研究接到知识产权与发展研究。
brief.main_en: Every definition of authenticity is also an exclusion.
brief.flow_en: From protective effects to exclusionary mechanisms to policy suggestions.
brief.link_en: Connects food studies to intellectual property and development.

toc.note_zh: 全书五章，章题据通行版式（Penguin / Vintage）；具体页码未逐页核对。
toc.note_en: Five chapters following the common edition (Penguin / Vintage); page numbers not checked page by page.

plot_acts.zh: Mintz 从「吃什么」与「和谁吃」的关系入手，指出食物从来不是营养问题，而是社会关系的标记与再生产。
plot_acts.en: Mintz starts from the relation between what we eat and whom we eat with, arguing food is never a matter of nutrition alone but a marker and reproduction of social relations.

brief.main: 饮食是社会结构的语法。
brief.flow: 从共食，到等级，再到意义。
brief.link: 为糖的个案提供理论入口。
brief.main_en: Eating is the grammar of social structure.
brief.flow_en: From commensality to hierarchy to meaning.
brief.link_en: Provides the theoretical entry to the sugar case.

plot_acts.title_zh: 生产：种植园、奴隶制与资本
plot_acts.zh: 糖的生产是近代世界体系的缩影：加勒比种植园、非洲奴隶贸易、英国资本与海军保护共同构成一条跨国生产链。
plot_acts.en: Sugar production condenses the modern world-system: Caribbean plantations, the African slave trade, British capital and naval protection form one transnational chain.

brief.main: 甜的代价是奴役与殖民。
brief.flow: 从种植园，到贸易路线，再到帝国财政。
brief.names: 巴巴多斯、牙买加、利物浦商人。
brief.link: 把消费史锚定在生产史。
brief.main_en: The price of sweetness was slavery and colonisation.
brief.flow_en: From plantation to trade route to imperial finance.
brief.link_en: Anchors consumption history in production history.

plot_acts.title_zh: 消费：从奢侈品到工人日常
plot_acts.title_en: Consumption: from luxury to working-class staple
plot_acts.zh: 核心转折：糖在两百多年间从贵族药品与装饰变成工人茶里的热量来源，这一变化由价格、税收、广告与工厂作息共同推动。
plot_acts.en: The central turn: over two centuries sugar moved from aristocratic medicine and ornament to the calorie source in the worker's tea, driven by price, tax, advertising and factory time.

brief.main: 口味是被价格与作息训练出来的。
brief.flow: 从稀缺，到降价，再到日常化。
brief.link: 解释「甜」如何成为阶级经验。
brief.main_en: Taste is trained by price and by the working day.
brief.flow_en: From scarcity to falling price to everyday use.
brief.link_en: Explains how sweetness became class experience.

plot_acts.zh: Mintz 追问：为什么工人接受了这种高热量、低营养的饮食？答案在权力——不是强迫，而是让某种饮食成为「正常」的能力。
plot_acts.en: Mintz asks why workers accepted this high-calorie, low-nutrition diet; the answer is power — not coercion but the capacity to make a diet seem normal.

brief.main: 最有效的支配，是让人以为自己在选择。
brief.flow: 从供给，到习惯，再到正当性。
brief.link: 把消费史提升为权力分析。
brief.main_en: The most effective domination makes people believe they are choosing.
brief.flow_en: From supply to habit to legitimacy.
brief.link_en: Raises consumption history into an analysis of power.

plot_acts.title_zh: 吃与存在：糖的当代遗产
plot_acts.title_en: Eating and being: sugar's present legacy
plot_acts.zh: 结尾把历史拉回当下：糖的日常化留下的是饮食结构、健康不平等与全球糖业的政治，它们至今仍在塑造「吃什么」。
plot_acts.en: The close returns history to the present: the normalisation of sugar left behind dietary structure, health inequality and the politics of the global sugar industry, still shaping what we eat.

brief.main: 历史没有结束，它变成了我们的口味。
brief.flow: 从历史，到当代饮食，再到健康政治。
brief.names: 消费者、食品工业、公共卫生。
brief.link: 把个案扩展为现代性的诊断。
brief.main_en: History did not end; it became our taste.
brief.flow_en: From history to contemporary diet to health politics.
brief.link_en: Widens the case into a diagnosis of modernity.
